---
title: Slide-Based Magic Move Demo
format: revealjs
revealjs-plugins:
  - magic-move
---

## Slope = 20 {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "before"
#| dev: svg
library(ggplot2)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(mpg, disp)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 20, intercept = 0, linewidth = 5, color = "pink") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)+
  lims(x = c(10, 35), y = c(100, 500))
```

## Slope = 10 {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "after"
#| dev: svg
library(ggplot2)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(mpg, disp)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 10, intercept = 0, linewidth = 5, color = "pink") +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)+
  lims(x = c(10, 35), y = c(100, 500))
```

## Slope = 10 + jitter {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "jitter"
#| dev: svg
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1234)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(mpg, disp)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 10, intercept = 0, linewidth = 5, color = "pink") +
  geom_jitter(width = 2, height = 5, size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  lims(x = c(10, 35), y = c(100, 500))
```

## Histogram - Normal {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "hist-normal"
#| dev: svg
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(42)
data.frame(x = rnorm(1000, mean = 0, sd = 1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  lims(x = c(-5, 5), y = c(0, 200))
```

## Histogram - Shifted {.magic-move}

```{r}
#| label: "hist-shifted"
#| dev: svg
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(42)
data.frame(x = rnorm(1000, mean = 2, sd = 1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  lims(x = c(-5, 5), y = c(0, 200))
```
